item.summary: fix(doctor): stop prompting a guaranteed no-op and surface the real migration error (#123164) Two doctor auth-repair UX defects: 1. When only unreferenced legacy Codex OAuth sidecar files remain (no stores with active profiles), doctor prompted 'Migrate legacy Codex OAuth credentials now?' on every interactive run even though the repair loop never touches unreferenced sidecars — answering yes changed nothing, forever. Gate the confirm prompt on actionable stores; unreferenced sidecars stay informational warnings. 2. The shared legacy oauth.json migration failure warning discarded the underlying error (SQLite unreadable, lock contention, source changed), leaving the user with no cause and no next step while the gateway stays blocked. Append the cause like the sibling per-candidate handler does.
